newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: PanAmSat opens African marketing office.
newsitem.headline: PanAmSat opens African marketing office.

text.p: PanAmSat, the world's first private sector satellite operator, said on Wednesday it had opened its first marketing office in Africa in Johannesburg.
"PanAmSat is ready in space and on the ground to serve Africa's growing satellite broadcasting and telecommunications market," chief executive Frederick Landman said in a statement.
PanAmSat currently has two satellites serving Africa, PAS-3 and PAS-4, and a third, PAS-7 is set for launch late next year.
The PAS-7 satellite will contain 14 C-band and 30 Ku-band transponders and operate in the same orbital location as PAS-4.
South Africa's satellite television market is set for an expansion with two new networks, AstraSat and Uplink Broadcasting Ltd, planned for launch in the next six months.
